name: story-blocks
vibe: An edited-video look with no parked layouts — bold editorial colour panels travelling in from alternating sides, tilted ticker rails marching opposite ways, rotating starbursts, and a full-field colour block for every scene so no two cuts land on the same ground. Condensed uppercase display type, thick ink outlines with hard offset shadows, and a hard block wipe whose edge rotates so the film never arrives from the same side twice. Brand colour repaints every panel, rail, block and field. Portrait-native 9:16. Best for editorial, media, sport and campaign brands.
